breakdown.description: The prompt mixes true and engineering measures by using the current area and current length while asking for engineering stress and engineering strain.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still mixes true/current measures with engineering measures. It explicitly computes the current cross-sectional area A using volume constancy (A = A0·L0/L) and then calculates stress as σ = P/A using that current area. True engineering stress must use the initial area A0 (σ = P/A0), not the current area. The ground truth simply asks for engineering stress and engineering strain using initial dimensions (A0 and L0), but the agent perpetuated the original error by basing the stress calculation on the deformed geometry.
